Name: Soap and Scrub - Immersive Hygiene System
Author: acharles1
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Soap & Scrub[/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=2][b]Sparkly when clean. Stinky when dirty. Simple as that.[/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=2]Take a bath and your farmer gets a cute sparkling Clean effect.[/size][/center]
[center][size=2]Skip bathing for a day and you may wake up the next morning pretty stinky![/size][/center]

[size=3][b]FEATURES[/b][/size]
[size=2]No percentages.[/size]
[size=2]No hygiene meter.[/size]
[size=2]No complicated system.[/size]
[size=2]Just try not to smell.[/size]

[b][size=3]How it works[/size][/b]
[size=2]- Craft a Soap Scrub using: 10 Fiber + 1 Any Flower[/size]
[size=2]- Use it inside your farmhouse or near water to take a bath.[/size]
[size=2]- Soap Scrub can also be purchased from:[/size]
[size=2]  - Pierre's General Store — 20g[/size]
[size=2]  - JojaMart — 20g[/size]

[size=3][b]Bathing:[/b][/size]
[size=2]- By default, Clean lasts 2 in-game hours.[/size]
[size=2]- While Clean, talking to villagers gives: +20 Friendship[/size]
[size=2]- Bathing again simply refreshes the timer.[/size]
[size=2]- Works at normal water sources, the Spa / Hot Springs, and while swimming with compatible swim mods[/size]

[b][size=3]NEW V2: Bees Plus Compatibility[/size][/b]
[size=2] If you have Bees Plus installed, its soap can be added to your Soap Scrub for a deeper clean.[/size]
[size=2]- Soap Scrub only → Clean for 2 hours[/size]
[size=2]- Soap Scrub + Soap → Clean for 4 hours[/size]
[size=2]- Soap Scrub + Floral Soap → Clean for 6 hours and +1 Defense[/size]
[size=2][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[size=2]Special thanks to [b]omena007[/b] for the [b]Soap Scrub sponge sprite[/b] and also for giving permission to Bees Plus Compatibility.[/size]


[b][size=3]Forgot to bathe?[/size][/b]
[size=2]-Go an entire day without washing and you'll wake up Dirty the next morning.You'll know immediately because your farmer gets a very noticeable green stinky cloud following them around.[/size]

[b][size=3]While Dirty:[/size][/b]
[size=2]- villagers react badly to your smell[/size]
[size=2]- conversations give -45 Friendship [/size]
[size=2]- villagers can make a sick reaction[/size]
[size=2]- you gain +1 Farming ,+1 Mining  +1 Combat[/size]
[size=2]- Dirty stays active until you finally take a bath.[/size]

[b][size=3]Rain, Spa & Swimming[/size][/b]
[size=2]Getting soaked can wash away the visible grime too. [/size]
[size=2]- Stay outside in rain for 10 in-game minutes while Dirty → return to Normal[/size]
[size=2]- Stay in the Spa / Hot Springs water for 10 in-game minutes while Dirty → return to Normal[/size]
[size=2]- Swimming with a compatible swim mod can do the same[/size]
[size=2] [/size]
[size=2]This does [b]not [/b]count as a proper bath.[/size]
[size=2] [/size]
[size=2]So if you don't use Soap Scrub that day, you can still wake up Dirty again the next morning.[/size]

[b][size=3]Linus[/size][/b]
[size=2]-Linus doesn't care. Clean or Dirty, he won't give you any hygiene-based friendship bonus, penalty, or sick reaction.[/size]

[b][size=3]Where the idea came from[/size][/b]
[size=2]Soap & Scrub grew out of an older hygiene idea I originally posted on Nexus.
You can see the original discussion here:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40811?tab=posts&utm_source=chatgpt.com]Original hygiene idea discussion[/url]
That idea later inspired another hygiene mod, and eventually I came back to the concept with the version I personally wanted to play:
simple Clean and Dirty states, strong visual feedback, and no percentage meter.[/size]

[b][size=3]Compatibility[/size][/b]
[size=2][b]- Soap & Scrub supports Generic Mod Config Menu. [/b][/size]
[size=2]- Designed to stay lightweight and avoid unnecessary changes to vanilla content.[/size]
[size=2]Built with modded playthroughs in mind.[/size]


[heading][size=3]Requirements[/size][/heading]
SMAPI
[size=2]Generic Mod Config Menu recommended.[/size]
[heading][size=2]Installation[/size][/heading]
[size=2]Extract the mod into:[/size]
[size=2]Stardew Valley/Mods[/size]
[size=2]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/size]
